name: Arctiguana
abilities: Freeze-ray breath (freezes water and even molten lava)
weaknesses: No documented Weaknesses section on the wiki; ice-based powers are situational against heat
summary: Ben 10,000's ice-breathing blue iguana, later a regular for teen Ben in Omniverse, capable of freezing lava solid.
traits: Ultimate Arctiguana was only ever used by Albedo
Ultimate Ben borrowed his ice breath in Ben 10,000 Returns
notableFeats: Froze the Kraaho's lava flow (Hot Stretch)
Fought Eon's minions alongside Gwen and Rook (Ben Again)
Fought Simian and Deefus Veeblepister (Collect This)

appearances.designNotes: Small facial spikes, three dorsal fins, white gills on the head, white pants and black open-front shirt with white cuffs, Omnitrix on the left hand.

Clothing extends up to the head with a white underbelly shell covering the chest, four pointed fins, face stripes go around the mouth, chin spikes, no visible gills, pointier claws, Omnitrix on the chest.

scoring.rationale: Reliable ranged freeze breath strong enough to solidify lava and lock down big foes, backed by decent toughness; little else in his kit and average speed.

notes: Wiki has no Weaknesses section; weaknesses above are editorial inference.
OS use is by Ben 10,000 only. Not used in AF/UA (UA intro only; re-unlocked in Ben 10,000 Returns).
OV 'Ben Again': 11-year-old Ben's mind in 16-year-old Ben's body used the 16-year-old design (counted as ben-16-ov).
Ultimate Arctiguana was used only by Albedo (For a Few Brains More) - it is not a Ben appearance.
